transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. As you know, we have an urgent order for two laser-cut housing variants, H-22 and H-31, that must be completed this week. Cell 4 is idle and ready, and Cell 5 can be freed up after its current batch. Before I finalize the production plan, I'd like to hear from each of you — quality, logistics, and maintenance — on any findings or concerns you have regarding running this campaign across Cells 4 and 5. Let's start the standard campaign review.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical quality requirement before we finalize the plan. The customer-approved drawing revision requires 24 first-off units across the H-22 and H-31 campaign to receive 100% dimensional inspection before release. I confirmed this in the customer quality portal yesterday, but the revised requirement has not yet been attached to the campaign traveler. We need to make sure this inspection step is built into the plan and the traveler is updated accordingly.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I have the confirmed shipping details that haven't been entered into the production schedule yet. The order is for exactly 620 H-22 housings and 430 H-31 housings, and all units must be staged for shipment by Thursday at 16:00. I received the signed shipping instruction this morning. This Thursday deadline is critical for how we sequence the campaign across Cells 4 and 5.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I have an important maintenance finding that affects the campaign plan. Cell 4 already has the compatible 0.8 mm nozzle installed for both H-22 and H-31 variants, but we must complete exactly 120 minutes of optical warm-up and alignment before any cutting can begin. Cell 5, on the other hand, would require a five-hour nozzle changeover to support these variants. I should also note that my inspection note detailing all of this is still sitting in the maintenance folder — it hasn't been transferred to the campaign packet yet, which is why it wasn't visible during the standard review.
transcript.speaker: A4

commitments.detail: Update the campaign traveler to include the 24 first-off units with 100% dimensional inspection requirement per the customer-approved drawing revision.
Enter the confirmed shipping details into the production schedule: 620 H-22 and 430 H-31 housings staged by Thursday 16:00.
Transfer Jonas's inspection note from the maintenance folder to the campaign packet for full visibility.

Run the full H-22 and H-31 campaign on Cell 4 only, starting with 120 minutes of optical warm-up and alignment before any cutting begins. Cell 5 will not be used for this campaign due to the five-hour nozzle changeover requirement.
